operation: For each case, allocate ParserState(source, undefined, offset), call the exact consumeNumber parser once with diagnostics disabled, and fold isError, final offset, value/type/sign, and consumed-representation identity into a retained digest.
comparability: H/B/S/D/R run identical ordered case bytes and the identical consuming operation. Setup, ParserState allocation, semantic normalization, and digest folding are inside every timed invocation. A complete-input wrapper, number-start predicate, regex-only validation, tokenization, Number-only conversion, percentage/unit dispatch, and BBNF f64 emission are NON_COMPARABLE.

corpora.public: fixtures/public-cases.json prefix cases plus deterministic hostile materializations
corpora.holdout: one wholly fresh unrevealed corpus formed only after precursor freeze; no prior-generation byte/result/ciphertext reuse

precheck: Every public and revealed-holdout observation must equal the harness before timing; any throw, mismatch, mutation, or failure invalidates the candidate and all its timings.

schedule.case_order: byte order of stable fixture IDs
schedule.diagnostics: disabled before warmup and explicitly disabled again before measured rounds
schedule.exception_law: retain failure and stop; no retry erases it

statistics: Retain raw nanoseconds and invocations for every pair. Report median and MAD. A strict win requires the one-sided 95% paired bootstrap confidence interval (100000 resamples, xorshift32 seed 0x564e554d over per-round candidate/peer ratios) wholly below 1.0.
units: operations/second and nanoseconds/operation; source lengths are UTF-16 code units and are never labeled UTF-8 MB/s
allocation: Record peak RSS and heap delta when the host tool is available; otherwise record UNAVAILABLE with exact tool/runtime reason.
claims: Formation defines comparability only. No timing has run and no performance, feature, parser, integration, or production credit exists.
